title: The Perceptron
summary: Frank Rosenblatt published "The perceptron: A probabilistic model for information storage and organization in the brain" in Psychological Review in November 1958. The paper develops a theory for a hypothetical nervous system called a perceptron and presents it as a quantitative statistical approach to questions of recognition, memory, and behavior.
significance: A documented neural-network and machine-learning milestone establishing Rosenblatt's published perceptron formulation at a defensible month-level publication date, without treating that publication date as an inferred invention or machine-construction date.

verification.note: The American Psychological Association publisher record verifies Frank Rosenblatt, the article title, Psychological Review volume 65 issue 6, pages 386-408, DOI 10.1037/h0042519, and publication year 1958. PubMed independently records the article as 1958 Nov;65(6):386-408 with the same DOI. Month precision is therefore retained. This record does not infer an exact publication day, a perceptron invention date, hardware-construction date, development geography, ancestry, influence, or causal relationships.
